responsibility: Implements the Arm NEON/AdvSIMD machine-description patterns for vector code generation. It defines register and memory move patterns, vector arithmetic, BF16 and dot-product operations, lane and structure accesses, conversions, table lookups, scalar/vector mixed forms, and many other AdvSIMD instructions and expanders, providing the main lowering layer from GCC vector RTL and builtins to NEON assembly.
